TOEFL (iBT) and (iBT Paper)

Please note: TOEFL iBT has introduced a new 1–6 banded score system with 0.5-point increments on 21 January 2026.

Imperial  will continue to accept the TOEFL iBT after 21 January 2026. Tests taken from this date onwards will need to meet the new score requirements in full. Tests taken before 21 January 2026 will be accepted according to the old requirement as long as they are taken within the two-years of the start date of your course. For more information on the test update please refer to the test provider's website.

*ETS at Home accepted for admission

*Test scores are only considered valid if taken within 2 years of the intended course start date. 

You must meet the entry requirement in one test from your scaled scores ('My Best Scores' reported by TOEFL will not be considered).

For more information relating regarding TOEFL please visit the ETS website. 

You must email your TOEFL scores to the relevant admissions teams.

Score reports sent via post will not be processed.
